global: Long-form explainer (everyone on Earth jumps at once). Off-white canvas, black line art; red reserved for labels, dashed measure lines, map pins/routes/arrows, prohibition signs, scribbles and handheld phones; grey for maps, ground bands, the car and depth-faded side figures; one black space scene with the Earth. Opening presenter-and-whiteboard with question card; red series title card (animated mascot); then a world population map, a recurring crowd row (standing / jumping / landing / close-ups), a recurring boxed regional map with a hatched CROWD blob, seismograph, airport and plane-departure scenes, a car-exodus sequence, a graveyard map, a road-warrior convoy, an Earth rotation scene, an engraved warning rock; red end card.

motion: Mostly 1-frame pops/swaps (labels, pins, road segments f3609/f3627/f3643, poses, scale jumps f1966/f1978) on a static camera. Fades: THE EARTH ground band and label fade in f911-916; labels, dashed line and arrows fade out f1315-1320; restroom sign fades in f2952-2957 and out f3074-3079. Write-ons: red dashed line then 0.5m label f1011-1015. Wipe: density shading erased east to west f630-641. One cross-dissolve close-up to wide row f2724-2729. One translate: car drives out right with acceleration f3783-3800. Ripple arcs boil per frame from f1534. Series title card f494-538 animates every frame (mascot chews satellite, 1-16k px/frame; wordmark static). 28 hard cuts plus a hidden cut f538|f539.
continuity: Recurring crowd row with the same 16 figure designs (ponytail, beard, beanie etc.) across standing, jumping, landing, phone, city-sign and close-up states; the same boxed regional map frame is reused for CROWD blob, ripples, pins, roads, car call-out, dispersal arrows and graveyard; recurring airport terminal with three departing planes; the presenter/whiteboard only in the opening. Replace the series mascot, title card, end card, books and credits with original designs; replace the real-channel and website cards on the whiteboard (video thumbnail, blog and column cards) with invented sources; give the wizard and the road-warrior vehicles original designs.
